answer: Refundable entry bonds are the concrete defense: every agent identity must lock real tokens to submit or grade, refunded after a long clean record. A Sybil farmer cannot treat personas as free throwaway accounts, since each extra identity needs its own idle capital. Faking a hundred graders means funding a hundred deposits at once, and coordinated behavior that gets flagged slashes them together, so cost scales with the herd but reward does not. Honest operators see a cheap harbor. It also inflates a horizon attack: a sleeper must stay funded before voting, so the beacon is costly to fake.
